checks_run.procedure:
NEW probe DS, for the repair's drilldown.ts rewrite (asBuilt branch removed).

Setup: T1 and T2 in org A, each holding all five financial classes (with a validated and a submitted measurement); T2's amounts are 1000x T1's.

TL1 is scoped to T1 only. It calls every value metric (7 value states + value.gap) x valueClass (none, 5 financial classes, non_financial_valued) x transformation filter (none, T1, T2, T1+T2), and compares each answer with AUD filtered to T1. It also calls every value-state metric with a T2 benefit as subjectId. ADM-only and the outsider call every metric x class. TL1 then follows every value headline href of the T1 dashboard and header. A control checks that AUD with no filter sees T1+T2.
checks_run.environment: Node 22.22.2, LANG unset, disposable PostgreSQL 16, probe clone at c94b2a2
checks_run.expected: TL1 sees only T1, identical to AUD-filtered-to-T1. T2 or T1+T2 gives 404. A T2 subjectId is never 200. Nothing of T2 (or of org A, for ADM/OUT) appears in any body.
checks_run.actual:
Revision 2: 163/163 passed, exit 0.
- Control: AUD with no filter gets 92592.5 (T1+T2); filtered to T1 it gets 92.5. So the probe detects a leak.
- TL1, no filter and T1 filter: byte-equal to AUD-T1 in value, items, calculation, headlineBasis and evidence. valueClass on value.gap gives 422 dashboard.value_class_not_applicable.
- TL1, T2 and T1+T2 filters: 112 x 404 not_found.
- A T2 subjectId: 245 x 422 dashboard.metric_subject_mismatch, the documented code. A random id gets the same answer, so it is no existence oracle.
- ADM-only and outsider: 224 x 404.
- The 15 headline hrefs return 200 with the right basis.
- leaked=0 on every line.

Disclosure: revision 1 exited 1. Its URLs used limit=200, above PAGINATION.maxLimit, so every call was 400 and all its tests failed. That was a probe error, not product behaviour. Revision 2 uses limit=100.

Finding, Medium, not mandatory, owner kpi-benefits-engineer: F-DG4-105.
- What happens: in a scope where USD holds no profit-and-cash benefit beside a SAR one, the USD profit-and-cash headline is not_applicable, but its drill-down returns value SAR 70 with the SAR item. The USD gross line, a known 0, shares the same href.
- Why: valueDrill (drilldown.ts from line 145) takes its currencies from the eligible profit-and-cash benefits only (line 185), and the href carries no currency (oneCurrency, line 213).
- What it contradicts: KBE-R6 handback §5.3(a) ('n/a ... with no item') and the n/a -> no-item rule of headline-basis.test.ts, which does not cover this case.
- Scope: there is no leak across transformations, and no stored or computed amount is wrong. The per-currency sum (USD: 0) still holds.

Observation, not a finding: the Finance gross line stays a known 0 beside the n/a headline. KBE-R6 disclosed this as design choice (a) for the domain reviewer. It conflicts with the wording of ADR-0030 N3 item 1 ('the same figure').

The repair diff contains no regression beyond F-DG4-105.
